tagline: Forno Rosso cooks fresh pasta and tiramisu in Mumbai, open 12pm to 11pm.
about: One focus: fresh pasta, tiramisu and wood-fired pizza in Mumbai. Small questions are welcome too.

features.title: Wood-fired Pizza
features.text: Baked in a wood-fired oven, so the crust blisters and the edges char. Wood-fired pizza: ask for details before you decide.

features.title: Fresh Pasta
features.text: Bring your questions about fresh pasta.

features.title: Tiramisu
features.text: Coffee-soaked sponge layered with mascarpone cream and cocoa. A good place to start if you like tiramisu.
